approval_policy.description: Approval policy for the Client Reporting Agent

send_report_to_client.notes: The AM reviews, edits, and sends the report to the client themselves. The agent has no client-facing send path.

add_client.notes: A new client means a new USER.md block, new namespaced credentials, and a redeploy. The agent never adds clients itself.

emergency_stop.notes: Any AM or the owner can stop posting immediately. Only the owner can resume.

forbidden.cross_client_data_sharing: One client's data in another client's report or thread. Not approvable by anyone.
forbidden.agent_sends_to_client: Any agent-initiated message to a client. Not approvable by anyone.
